items.description: reading the stock-by-location list through the boundary returns a JSON collection with one entry per seeded stock_records row (unique uuid-suffixed sku/location, cleaned up after) carrying that record's sku, location, and quantity, read through service and repository against the branch DB

read-path row shaping/ordering (the list DTO) lives in the service and the query is the repository's sole ORM touch; the boundary and React component contain no shaping or ORM logic (read-path layering contract)
the stock-by-location table component renders one row per record showing its SKU, location, and quantity via its data-testid seams (client component)
the quantity-column cells carry their right-align design-guide class / data-testid seam (the stable contract), asserted via the seam rather than any inline style or raw CSS (client component)

reading a location with no stock records (a unique uuid-suffixed location that owns no rows) through the boundary returns an empty JSON collection with a success status, not a 404 or error payload, read through service and repository against the branch DB
the table component maps an empty collection to the explicit "No stock at this location" empty state via its data-testid seam rather than a blank page (client component)
